title: A river with a reversible past
prompt:
A ring of 31 binary cells evolved for exactly 37 synchronous steps under elementary rule 150.
next[i]=old[i-1] XOR old[i] XOR old[i+1], indices modulo 31. The leftmost printed bit is index 0.
Final state: 0000111001100101011010010111110
Find the unique original 31-bit state. Preserve leading zeroes. Work over F_2.
